verified_key_information_units.information: Gigasun's installed solar capacity increased to 395.8 MW from 340.1 MW, representing a 16% year-over-year growth and expanding its portfolio to 216 electricity-generating installations.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: On 31 December 2025, Gigasun had a portfolio of 216 (200) electricity-generating solar energy installations with a total capacity of 395.8 (340.1) MW.

candidate_sentences.text: During 2025, the company increased its total installed capacity of roof-mounted solar energy installations to 395.8 megawatts across 216 installations, up from 340.1 megawatts across 200 installations at the end of 2024.

verified_key_information_units.information: Gigasun reported revenue of SEK 239.7 million (up 9.8% YoY) and operating profit of SEK 73.5 million (up 21.1% YoY). Net profit was SEK -7.2 million, impacted by a SEK 3.8 million currency effect and SEK 3.5 million one-off cost; excluding these items, adjusted net profit was SEK 0.1 million. The full-year profit increase was significantly driven by a record Q3 with production up 36% and profit up 275% compared to Q3 2024.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Revenues amounted to SEK 239.7 (218.3) million... Operating profit amounted to SEK 73.5 (60.7) million... Profit after tax amounted to SEK -7.2 (-32.9) million and were impacted by a non-cash currency effect of SEK -3.8 (1.8) million as well as a one-off cost of SEK 3.5 million... The most notable development during the year was our record quarter in Q3. Production increased by 36 percent and profit rose by as much as 275 percent compared with the same period the previous year.

candidate_sentences.text: Gigasun AB reported total revenues of 239,655 thousand Swedish kronor for the 2025 financial year, representing an increase compared to 218,264 thousand Swedish kronor in the previous year.

Operating profit improved by 21.1 percent to 73,478 thousand Swedish kronor from 60,677 thousand Swedish kronor, and the operating margin increased to 31 percent compared to 28 percent in the previous period.

Profit after tax improved to negative 7,206 thousand Swedish kronor compared to negative 32,944 thousand Swedish kronor in the preceding year, resulting in earnings per share of negative 0.13 Swedish kronor compared to negative 0.58 Swedish kronor previously.

However, revenues were partially offset by negative currency effects of 18.0 million Swedish kronor and lower average prices resulting from a higher share of electricity sold to the grid and revised tariffs in the second half of the year.

verified_key_information_units.information: The company secured new financing of SEK 372 million through its Chinese subsidiary, extended loan amortization to 10 years at improved rates (3.60%), and postponed the SOLT4 bond repayment to November 8, 2026, enhancing liquidity and reducing financing costs.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: The company has entered into two agreements with the Chinese company Agricultural Bank Financial Leasing Co., Ltd to refinance approximately SEK 1,242 millions... The interest rate on the new financing is 3.60% and the amortization period has been extended from 7 to 10 years... The remaining bond, SOLT4, has been extended to November 8, 2026.

candidate_sentences.text: Financially, Gigasun entered into agreements with Agricultural Bank Financial Leasing Co., Ltd to refinance approximately 1,242 million Swedish kronor to repay sale and leaseback facilities with JiangSu Financial Leasing Co., Ltd, which contributed to lower interest expenses of 76,944 thousand Swedish kronor compared to 84,165 thousand Swedish kronor.
The remaining SOLT4 bond was extended to November 8, 2026.

verified_key_information_units.information: Gigasun expanded into new regions such as Chongqing where declining construction costs now make solar viable, while navigating regulatory tariff adjustments in Jiangsu and Anhui provinces that reduced realized kWh prices by approximately 8% in H2 2025, impacting revenue by an estimated 3-4%.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Our geographical expansion also continues... expanded into Chongqing... electricity tariffs in the Jiangsu and Anhui provinces were adjusted... reduced the realized price per kWh by approximately 8 percent in the second half of the year... impact on our existing project portfolio is manageable and amounts to approximately a 3–4 percent reduction in revenue.

verified_key_information_units.information: Total electricity production reached 327.8 million kWh in 2025 (up 30% YoY), reducing CO2 emissions by approximately 161,000 tonnes (vs 124,000 tonnes in 2024), contributing to China's climate transition.

All statements are consistent with each other, and the relationships between financial metrics (revenues, profits, margins, expenses) are logically presented. The summary flows logically from revenue performance through profitability metrics to operational drivers and balance sheet items.
